Method of Attack: Backdoor in binary files added to the xz repository, piggybacking off functions called by sshd. The backdoor code was injected only if a specific 'build-to-host.m4' file was present during compilation, but this file was added to '.gitignore'. The malicious code targeted x86-64 systems running glibc and using systemd.
Attack Vector: Compromised build process of the xz package, which included malicious binary files and a subtle change to CMakeLists.txt to bypass landlock security features.
Indicators of Compromise: Unexplained CPU usage delay in sshd (500 ms)
presence of specific public key required for activation of the backdoor.
